ConnectionStrings.//: Real connection strings are supplied via environment (ConnectionStrings__ReturnLoadDatabase) or appsettings.Development.json. Never commit production credentials (01_PROJECT_RULES.md §1).

Jwt.//: Framework wiring only (no token issuance yet). SigningKey MUST come from a secret store / environment variable in real environments; startup fails outside Development if it is missing.

Security.//: M1.5 hardening. HttpsRedirection/Hsts apply outside Development.

Cors.//: Explicit allowlist. Empty = no cross-origin browser access. Set per environment / CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS.

FileStorage.//: Local-disk dev backend (ADR-0012). A cloud object store replaces this later.

Geo.//: M4.2 location intelligence. Dev = public OpenStreetMap Nominatim + OSRM (no key). Point at a self-hosted instance or swap a Google adapter in production. Respect the OSM usage policy (User-Agent, rate).

Matching.//: M5 ranking weights (relative, normalised to 0-100) + radii. Tunable per-lane later.
